note: Names and descriptions are PlayStation's official list. Guides are this entry's own words, built from those descriptions; where a location or step is not pinned down by the description, the guide says so plainly. Sources are named per trophy.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum lands the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned. Follow the roadmap tiers in order: story path first, then open world and side strands, then the grind, and the platinum is the last thing you collect.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to its end. It is the first mission of the story, so this is the first trophy most players earn.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Chapter trophies unlock automatically when the chapter's last mission ends, so just play the story through.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies it unlocks on its own when the chapter closes.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. Automatic on chapter completion.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. Automatic on chapter completion.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the story's final mission. It is gold because it closes the whole story; there is no way to miss it if you play the story to the end.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Breakfast Run. It only exists inside its story moment, so clear it on your first pass through the story; if the game offers mission replay from the pause menu, replay is your safety net.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission The Cartel Heist. Same rule as the other named missions: its only window is the mission itself, so do it when the story hands it to you.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Child's Play. Clear it on your first pass; the mission is the only place this trophy lives.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Headliners. First-pass only: the trophy's window is that mission.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission VCIA Takedown at the airport. Its window is the mission itself, so take it when the story offers it.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Operation Savage Glory. First-pass only, like the other named missions.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion: every story mission, side strand, activity, collectible and challenge the game counts. This is the long tail of the platinum — leave it for last and use the checklist to see what is still open. The exact 100% checklist is the in-game stats screen; community guides (PowerPyx, PSNProfiles) keep a running list of what counts.
trophies.source: Official trophy description (PlayStation). Route details: PowerPyx, PSNProfiles GTA 6 guides.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts: jumps, near misses, airtime and drifts all count toward the stunt total. It accumulates across the whole game, so just play aggressively and check the counter in the stats screen; a stunt jump hotspot makes the last stretch faster.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once each: fishing, racing, shooting range, drone races, arcade, bowling, meditation, hunting and the rest the game offers. One try each is enough — you do not need to win or finish them.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges. This is the hardest pure-skill trophy on the list: learn each range's target pattern, use the most stable weapon you own, and repeat a challenge until the gold time or score clicks. Do it in short sessions — it is a grind, not a sprint.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location has its own course; learn the gates on a practice run, then race to win. The map marks the race spots once you have found them.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different events, not the same race 20 times. Enter races from the map across Leonida and work through the list; street, off-road and circuit races all count.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at a fishing spot, take his challenge and out-fish him: steady reeling beats fast reeling, and the right bait for the spot matters more than luck.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game at an arcade cabinet. Any game counts — pick the shortest one and play it through to its end screen.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's last mission. Character strands end when their final mission is done, so take Andy's missions as they appear and close his strand before the story moves past him.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's last mission. Same rule as Andy's strand: character finales only exist while the strand is open, so close it on your first pass.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's last mission. Close the strand while it is open — once his story is done, its final mission is gone.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Strangers appear as map icons as you explore; each strand is a short chain of missions. Do them as you find them rather than leaving all 8 for the end.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's last mission. Close his strand on your first pass, before the story moves on.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's last mission. Same first-pass rule as the other character finales.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. Meditation spots are quiet scenic places on the map; visit each and complete the meditation. A checklist of the 18 is the only sane way to track this — use the tracker's filter to tick them off one by one.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Bret marks the hunt for you; track the animal, take the shot cleanly, and bring back the proof. The exact animal and ground are named in Bret's strand, so follow his directions rather than wandering.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida in shops, stashes and mission rewards; a set is complete when every card in it is found. Track sets, not single cards — finish one set before starting another.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK spots are spread across the whole state; each one used counts once, so sweep the map region by region and tick them off as you go.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Finish 50 challenges. Challenges are the game's side objectives — races, stunts, hunts and more — and they pile up naturally as you play. Check the challenges list for the shortest ones when you need the last few.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose it and escape. Your partner is only with you during certain story stretches, so do this while the story keeps you paired — after the finale there may be nobody to escape with. Fast car, open road, and break line of sight.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without losing your wanted level. Same partner rule as Hot Together: do it while the story keeps you paired. Pick three shops close together, keep the getaway car ready, and do not stop between robberies.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Every new vehicle you drive or park counts once; the counter climbs fastest if you steal or buy a different car every time you travel instead of keeping one favourite.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies during one Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus in a fight with a crowd — a gang shootout or a wanted-level chase — and chain the kills before the focus ends. Ammo and cover first, then activate.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave VCIA (the airport) in an unscheduled way — take a plane or vehicle out without following the normal departure. Airport access is story-gated, so do this while the story still takes you through VCIA; after the story moves on, the airfield may be closed to you.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Deal with the Rhinos — the tanks. The description is a joke, not a map: the trophy is about surviving or defeating a Rhino tank encounter. Bring heavy weapons, keep moving, and do not fight one on foot in the open.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being seen. Go at night, move quietly, take what you need and leave before the alarm or the cameras catch you. If you are spotted, walk away and try another store another night.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Vaults are the big robberies: plan the entry, crack the vault, and have the getaway ready before you go in. Five successful escapes, counted across the whole game.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob one armored truck and escape. Trucks run set routes around Leonida — spot one on the road, stop it, take the cash and get clear before the response arrives.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Drive every road, visit every named place, and watch the area counter climb. The last few areas are the ones you never had a reason to visit — use the map's unexplored shading to find them.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Each gang runs its own operations around Leonida; hit one per gang and the set is done. The gangs' territories are marked by who controls the streets there.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Find a beach bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and enjoy the view — the trophy is the moment, not a mission.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive a car straight through the showroom glass and out the other side. Pick a showroom with a clear exit line and a fast car.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley and follow through — finish a game there. The alley is a named place in Leonida; walk in, take a lane, and bowl.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership moment with mass appeal. This one is deliberately vague — the description is a riddle, not directions. It unlocks from a story partnership beat; play the story and it will come. Where the description pins nothing down, this guide says so plainly rather than inventing a location.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make choices — PSN tracks a count to 500. Every dialogue and story choice counts, so just play and choose; the counter climbs across the whole game and there is no wrong answer for this trophy.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try. Fail something, then do it again and succeed — the trophy is for the retry that works. Any failed-then-passed attempt counts.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange. Leonida hides odd events — a UFO, a cryptid, something that makes no sense. Keep your eyes open while exploring, especially at night and off the roads. The description names no place, so this guide names none either; it happens while you explore.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by — hit a pedestrian with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle. One clean hit is enough; a slow drive-by past a lone pedestrian does it.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; your contacts clean them for a cut. Keep robbing and keep laundering — the counter is cumulative, so it finishes itself if you keep the money moving.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Weapons, clothes, cars, food — every dollar at a shop counts. It accumulates across the whole game; if you are short at the end, buy and sell the most expensive thing you can afford.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties. Garages are bought from the property market once you have the money; each one also stores the cars you collect, so buy them as you can afford them.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. Find a vehicle, open the app, and register it — ten different vehicles, one registration each.
